claim: Archive POKs cannot be imported blindly: check each against the disassembly, translate addresses, and test every one per release.

evidence.text: One .pok entry is an address in the packed snapshot; the rest are live addresses the unpack overwrites; translated through the stream map.
The .pok's [L1] lines name another release's addresses (data or mid-instruction here); only some work, proven on the simulator.
Infinite Lives also pokes 34925, a graphics pointer; the single-poke trainer is used.
Of 16 trainers, See Ending and Paralyzed Enemies freeze the game; Immunity still loses lives.
The archive POK has overlapping immunity variants at 40905.
The POK labelled 128K has 48K addresses; translated by matching instructions.
